facts.subject: Solen Energy coastal clean-up sponsorship
facts.statement: Solen Energy has agreed to fund a year of monthly beach clean-ups along the northern coast.

source_ref.text_snippet: Solen Energy has agreed to fund a year of monthly beach clean-ups along the northern coast.

facts.subject: Solen Energy coastal clean-up sponsorship
facts.statement: The company will pay for gloves, bags and a small truck, while local volunteers will organise the work itself.

source_ref.text_snippet: The company will pay for gloves, bags and a small truck, while local volunteers will organise the work itself.

facts.subject: First clean-up event
facts.statement: The first clean-up is planned for the last weekend of the month.

source_ref.text_snippet: The first clean-up is planned for the last weekend of the month.

facts.subject: First clean-up event
facts.statement: Volunteers will meet at a car park near the dunes and work in small groups, with a hot drink provided at the end of the morning.

source_ref.text_snippet: Volunteers will meet at a car park near the dunes and work in small groups, with a hot drink provided at the end of the morning.

facts.subject: Solen Energy community programme
facts.statement: A company spokesperson said the sponsorship is part of a wider community programme and does not change the firm's normal operations.

source_ref.text_snippet: A company spokesperson said the sponsorship is part of a wider community programme and does not change the firm's normal operations.

facts.subject: Litter data collection
facts.statement: Local organisers said they hope to collect data on the most common types of litter.

source_ref.text_snippet: Local organisers said they hope to collect data on the most common types of litter.
